decks.summary: All-rounder Poorston: Dark Horse and Fire Axe make him a reliable damage dealer, Flashlight, "Look what I found!" and Intel Report take clues, and Dig Deep with Leo De Luca covers treacheries.
Double, Double Preston who doubles Easy Mark, Emergency Cache and Hot Streak to build wealth, then doubles Intel Report, Small Favor and Sneak Attack for big plays; needs a team.
Solo Poorston built on Dark Horse, failure mitigation with Live and Learn and Lucky!, and tempo from Leo De Luca and Think on Your Feet, racing to Streetwise at 3 XP.
Dark Horse Preston who spends everything each turn, plays items for free through Joey "The Rat" Vigil, swings a Fire Axe, and buys clues with Lola Santiago and Streetwise.
Double, Double Preston who brings tests down to zero with Flashlight, Old Keyring, Gumption and Stealth to fire Exploit Weakness and Shed a Light, recurring events with Scrounge for Supplies.
Preston who refuses to take tests: Double, Double doubles Intel Report, Small Favor, Sneak Attack and Hot Streak, and Money Talks and Friends in Low Places buy the rest.
Hard-mode generalist Preston who pours his money into Well Connected and Money Talks for guaranteed successes, with Lone Wolf, Dario El-Amin and Drawing Thin feeding the pile.
Blessed Preston who seals bless on Favor of the Sun and Ancient Covenant to auto-succeed huge all-in turns with Eye of the Djinn, Lucky Cigarette Case and Quick Thinking; can be the only cluever.
Poorston: Dark Horse, Fire Axe and Dig Deep, Trial by Fire and Intel Report to spend everything, and Live and Learn and Lucky! to save tests.
Draw-engine Preston who fails tests on purpose with Drawing Thin, Rabbit's Foot and Take Heart, takes clues with Old Keyring and "Look what I found!", and doubles Black Market with Double, Double.
